mapping_boundary.guide_use: D1 supplies operating-practice context but does not define the logger tags, workbook-to-device mapping, sensor units or controller states.

claim_boundary: The 15 CC BY 4.0 workbooks are real public experimental traces and can support post-access component diagnostics, including descriptive flow-to-scale mass closure. Outcomes were inspected before this audit and the release lacks an authoritative tag/unit dictionary, device crosswalk, vehicle geometry and station controller states. It therefore does not establish prospective validation, a complete HRS-to-vehicle full-loop result, safety performance or regulatory compliance.
